mnemonic.meaning: Money (金) that's present (現) in your hand right now. Cash.
mnemonic.reading: GEN, KIN (げんきん): Gen pays his kin in cash.

examples.ja: 現金で払います。
examples.en: I'll pay in cash.

items.note: As な adjective: 現金な人 = someone who acts only for gain.

mnemonic.meaning: MA, BOO, SHE (まぶしい): Ma covers her eyes and says "boo": she's dazzled by the bright sun.

examples.ja: 夏の太陽がまぶしい。
examples.en: The summer sun is dazzling.

items.note: Also figurative: dazzlingly beautiful. Kanji: 眩しい.

mnemonic.meaning: The shape (形) and condition (態). A form, a system.
mnemonic.reading: KAY TIE (けいたい): Kay's tie has a strange form. Same sound as 携帯 (cell phone).

examples.ja: 働き方の形態が変わってきた。
examples.en: The forms of working have changed.

items.note: Formal, academic. 形 (かたち) is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Study (学) and learn (習). Learning.
mnemonic.reading: GACK, SHOE (がくしゅう): learning so hard you chew your shoe. GACK!

examples.ja: 毎日少しずつ日本語を学習している。
examples.en: I study Japanese a little every day.

items.note: Formal. 勉強 is everyday. 学習者 = learner.

mnemonic.meaning: See (見) and hit (当) the target. A guess, an estimate.
mnemonic.reading: KEN, TOE (けんとう): Ken guesses the size of your toe. Good estimate!

examples.ja: 彼がどこにいるか、全く見当がつかない。
examples.en: I have no idea where he is.

items.note: 見当がつく = to have an idea. 見当違い = off the mark.

mnemonic.meaning: 借 is borrow: something you borrowed. A debt, a favour owed.
mnemonic.reading: CARRY (かり): you carry the debt on your back.

examples.ja: 彼には借りがある。
examples.en: I owe him one.

items.note: 借りを返す = to repay a favour. 貸し = what you lent.

mnemonic.meaning: Rest (休) and take a breath (息). A break.
mnemonic.reading: CUE, SOCK (きゅうそく): on cue, take your socks off and rest.

examples.ja: 十分な休息をとってください。
examples.en: Please get enough rest.

items.note: Formal. 休憩 (Level 1) is a short break. 休み is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 祝 has 礻 (altar): a ceremony to celebrate. Congratulations!
mnemonic.reading: EE, WHY (いわい)? Why not celebrate?

examples.ja: 友達の結婚のお祝いを買った。
examples.en: I bought a wedding present for my friend.

items.note: Usually お祝い: a celebration or a gift for it.

mnemonic.meaning: Years (年) and months (月). Time passing.
mnemonic.reading: TOSHI, TSUKI (としつき): Toshi watches the moon (月) through the years.

examples.ja: 長い年月が過ぎた。
examples.en: Many long years have passed.

items.note: Literary. Also read ねんげつ with the same meaning.

mnemonic.meaning: 癌 has 疒 (sickness) + 品 (pile of goods) + 山 (mountain): lumps piling up like a mountain. Cancer.
mnemonic.reading: GONE (がん): cancer can make someone gone.

examples.ja: 祖父は癌で入院している。
examples.en: My grandfather is in hospital with cancer.

items.note: Often written in katakana: ガン or がん.

mnemonic.meaning: 賞 has 貝 (money): a money prize. An award.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW (しょう): you win the prize at the show.

examples.ja: 彼女は絵のコンクールで賞を取った。
examples.en: She won a prize in an art contest.

items.note: ノーベル賞 = Nobel Prize. 賞金 = prize money.

mnemonic.meaning: 広 is wide: you make it wide. To spread, to popularize.
mnemonic.reading: HERO, MEh-RUE (ひろめる): the hero spreads the news.

examples.ja: 日本の文化を世界に広めたい。
examples.en: I want to spread Japanese culture around the world.

items.note: Transitive partner of 広まる (Level 11).

mnemonic.meaning: Each piece (片) gets attached (付) to its place. Tidied up, settled.
mnemonic.reading: KATA, ZOO, KOO (かたづく): the zoo is all tidied up.

examples.ja: 部屋がやっと片付いた。
examples.en: The room is finally tidy.

items.note: Intransitive. 片付ける = you tidy it. Also 仕事が片付く (work gets done).

mnemonic.meaning: 害 has 宀 (roof) + 口 (mouth): a mouth under the roof says hurtful things. Harm.
mnemonic.reading: GUY (がい): the guy causes harm.

examples.ja: タバコは体に害がある。
examples.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.

items.note: 害虫 = pest, 被害 = damage.

mnemonic.meaning: 畳 is the tatami mat: you fold it up.
mnemonic.reading: TATA MOO (たたむ): the cow folds up her tatami mat.

examples.ja: 洗濯物を畳んだ。
examples.en: I folded the laundry.

items.note: 店を畳む = to close a shop for good.

mnemonic.meaning: 読 is read: how you read it. A reading, insight.
mnemonic.reading: YO, ME (よみ): "Yo, me, I can read!"

examples.ja: この漢字の読みを教えてください。
examples.en: Please tell me the reading of this kanji.

items.note: Also a prediction: 読みが当たる (your guess is right).

mnemonic.meaning: See (見) and solve (解). Your view, opinion.
mnemonic.reading: KEN, KITE (けんかい): Ken's opinion: kites are great.

examples.ja: 専門家の見解を聞きたい。
examples.en: I'd like to hear an expert's view.

items.note: Formal; official opinions. 意見 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 適 is suitable: to suit.
mnemonic.reading: TECHY SUE RUE (てきする): this techy job suits Sue, she won't rue it.

examples.ja: この土地は米作りに適している。
examples.en: This land is suitable for growing rice.

items.note: Usually 〜に適している. Formal.

mnemonic.meaning: Extinguish (消) and prevent (防) fires. Firefighting.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW BOW (しょうぼう): the firefighters bow at the end of the show.

examples.ja: 火事を見つけたら、すぐ消防に電話してください。
examples.en: If you spot a fire, call the fire department right away.

items.note: 消防車 = fire engine, 消防士 = firefighter, 消防署 = fire station. In Japan, call 119 for fire and ambulance.

mnemonic.meaning: GOOSE, SUE, REE (ぐっすり): the goose sleeps soundly next to Sue.

examples.ja: 昨夜はぐっすり眠った。
examples.en: I slept soundly last night.

items.note: Almost always with sleeping: ぐっすり寝る / 眠る.

mnemonic.meaning: The big (大) part (部分). Most of it.
mnemonic.reading: DIE BOO BOON (だいぶぶん): most of the ghosts say boo before they die.

examples.ja: 仕事の大部分は終わった。
examples.en: Most of the work is done.

items.note: Close to 大半 (Level 9) and ほとんど.

mnemonic.meaning: The summit (頂) up (上) top. The peak.
mnemonic.reading: CHO, JOE (ちょうじょう): Joe reaches the summit.

examples.ja: 山の頂上から日の出を見た。
examples.en: I watched the sunrise from the mountain top.

items.note: 頂上 = peak of a mountain, or a summit meeting (頂上会談).

mnemonic.meaning: The generation (代) of years (年). An era, a decade.
mnemonic.reading: NEN, DIE (ねんだい): each era will die.

examples.ja: 九十年代の音楽が好きだ。
examples.en: I like music from the nineties.

items.note: 〜年代 = decade. Also age group: 同じ年代 (the same generation).

mnemonic.meaning: Visit (参) and think (考). A reference.
mnemonic.reading: SAN, COKE (さんこう): Mr. San uses a Coke can as a reference.

examples.ja: 先輩の意見を参考にした。
examples.en: I took my senior's opinion into account.

items.note: 参考にする = use as a reference. 参考書 = study guide.

mnemonic.meaning: Public (公) and even (平). Fair, impartial.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, HAY (こうへい): the horse gets Coke and hay. Fair!

examples.ja: 先生は全員を公平に扱った。
examples.en: The teacher treated everyone fairly.

items.note: 不公平 = unfair. 平等 (Level 13) = equal.

mnemonic.meaning: 汲 has 氵 (water): you scoop up water.
mnemonic.reading: COO, MOO (くむ): the cow scoops water from the well.

examples.ja: 井戸から水を汲んだ。
examples.en: I drew water from the well.

items.note: Figurative: 気持ちを汲む (take someone's feelings into account).

mnemonic.meaning: Overcome (克) and make it obey (服). Conquest.
mnemonic.reading: COCK, FOO, COO (こくふく): the rooster overcomes the pigeon.

examples.ja: 彼は病気を克服した。
examples.en: He overcame his illness.

items.note: For difficulties, fears, illness: 苦手を克服する.

mnemonic.meaning: See (見) someone being sent (送り) off. Seeing off. Seeing off a plan means postponement.
mnemonic.reading: ME, OH, CURRY (みおくり): you see me off with curry.

examples.ja: 空港まで友達の見送りに行った。
examples.en: I went to the airport to see my friend off.

items.note: Also shelving a plan: 計画は見送りになった.

mnemonic.meaning: Two dry kanji (乾, 燥): dryness.
mnemonic.reading: CAN, SO (かんそう): the can is so dry. Same sound as 感想 (impressions).

examples.ja: 冬は空気が乾燥している。
examples.en: The air is dry in winter.

items.note: 乾燥機 = dryer. 乾く is everyday "to dry".

mnemonic.meaning: The suitable (適) degree (度). Moderate.
mnemonic.reading: TECHY DOUGH (てきど): the techy eats a moderate amount of dough.

examples.ja: 適度な運動は健康にいい。
examples.en: Moderate exercise is good for your health.

items.note: Not too much, not too little. 過度 (かど) = excessive.
